formal_documents.query: SELECT kind,id,version,data FROM documents WHERE kind IN ('definition','engine_state','alarm','active_alarm','revision','entity','data_catalog','compiled_plan') ORDER BY kind,id

observations.query: SELECT * FROM observations ORDER BY id,observed_ms

latest.query: SELECT * FROM latest ORDER BY device_id,key

rollups.query: SELECT * FROM rollups ORDER BY device_id,key,granularity,bucket_ms
